facts.text: Each suite is positioned along the Sand River in the Masai Mara.
facts.excerpt: Each luxurious suite is strategically positioned along the Sand River, offering sweeping views of golden savannahs, winding riverbanks, and distant acacia-dotted horizons.

facts.text: The camp sits among trees in the heart of the Masai Mara National Reserve.
facts.excerpt: Elevated among lush trees in the heart of the Masai Mara National Reserve

facts.text: Each suite is raised above the ground, so wildlife can roam freely below.
facts.excerpt: each suite is raised above the ground, allowing wildlife to roam freely below.

facts.text: The suites have private decks, plunge pools and personalized butler service.
facts.excerpt: feature private decks, plunge pools, personalized butler service and stunning views

facts.text: The butler service is called Encholiek, a Maasai word for someone who walks alongside you.
facts.excerpt: In Maasai tradition, an Encholiek is someone who walks alongside you, offering guidance, support, and companionship as needed.

facts.text: The two-bedroom suites are described as ideal for families, with treetop views.
facts.excerpt: An elevated retreat ideal for families, 2-bedroom suites offer treetop views and gracious space

facts.text: Stays include two game drives a day in a private open-air Safari Land Cruiser with certified guides.
facts.excerpt: Your stay includes two daily exclusive game drives in a private open-air Safari Land Cruiser, guided by certified tour guides.

facts.text: The guides are certified by the Kenya Professional Safari Guides Association.
facts.excerpt: Our tour guides are certified by The Kenya Professional Safari Guides Association (KPSGA)

facts.text: Nest is the main restaurant, with a restaurant deck, a private wine cellar, a sky deck for stargazing dinners and a Boma experience.
facts.excerpt: Immerse in the culinary journey of our main Masai Mara restaurant, featuring a private wine cellar, expansive restaurant deck, sky deck for stargazing dinners and an authentic Boma experience

facts.text: The Boma dinner is a fireside evening with storytelling, traditional Masai dances and a feast.
facts.excerpt: Gather around a crackling fire in our authentic Boma for a night of storytelling, traditional Masai dances, and a feast inspired by Africa’s rich culinary heritage.

facts.text: The private wine cellar offers tastings guided by a sommelier.
facts.excerpt: Step into our exclusive wine cellar for a personalized tasting guided by our sommelier.

facts.text: Whispering Tree Spa treatments use Acacia, Shea Butter and Aloe and draw on Maasai healing traditions.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by the healing traditions of the Maasai and the restorative power of nature, our signature treatments incorporate sacred Acacia, nourishing Shea Butter, and soothing Aloe

facts.text: The Wellness Hub has an open-air heated pool, a gym and a studio.
facts.excerpt: Stay active at our Wellness Hub with an open-air heated pool, gym, and studio.

facts.text: The Kenya-Tanzania Border Stone, a marker linking the Masai Mara and Serengeti, is steps away from the camp.
facts.excerpt: This Stone is steps away from the Camp.

facts.text: At dusk a Masai Moran sounds a traditional horn to mark the transition from day to night.
facts.excerpt: A Masai Moran, adorned in full regalia, sounds the horn signaling the transition from day to night.

facts.text: Guests can use professional Canon cameras at no charge on safari.
facts.excerpt: Capture the wonders of the Masai Mara with professional Canon cameras, complimentary for guests.

facts.text: The camp has a minimum age requirement of six years.
facts.excerpt: we have established a minimum age requirement of six years.

facts.text: The quickest way to reach the camp is by air, to the Keekorok airstrip, followed by a game drive to the camp.
facts.excerpt: On arrival at the Keekorok airstrip, you will be met by our team, followed by a 1-hour short game drive to the Camp.

facts.text: Hot air balloon safaris are available as an optional experience.
facts.excerpt: optional experiences such as hot air balloon safaris, Rhino Sanctuary visits and cultural visits.

facts.text: The Great Migration typically passes through the Masai Mara between July and October.
facts.excerpt: The Great Migration typically passes through the Masai Mara between July and October
